transitive_runtime.coverage: system interpreter/stdlib/native tree; both venv pyvenv.cfg files and complete site-package source/native trees; every .pth is bound but never executed; interpreter/test cache directories and .pyc/.pyo are explicitly excluded derived state; workspace eval and meanaudio tree with exact package init; external evaluators; isolated -B -I -S bootstrap with source-only meanaudio/evaluator execution; absolute shell tools. Venv launcher symlinks, workspace bytecode caches, and the repository root are excluded from meanaudio/evaluator import authority.

runner.difference_from_original: Preserves scientific commands, gates the NVMe filesystem before preflight and every cell, writes generation/metrics/PEAV only beneath the staged NVMe final tree, and executes all Python through verified system-interpreter/script descriptors with an exact import path.

security_assumptions.isolated_import: All Python actions use the approval-bound /usr/bin/python3.12 descriptor with -X pycache_prefix=/dev/null -B -I -S and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1. The alternate invalid cache prefix prevents existing __pycache__ reads; the bootstrap rejects source-less legacy site bytecode, compiles exact evaluator and meanaudio .py sources directly, supplies only manifest-verified stdlib/site-package directories, and preloads meanaudio from its exact held __init__.py descriptor and package-only submodule search location; cwd, repository root, venv launchers, .pth execution, and bytecode-cache authority are excluded.
security_assumptions.unresolved_AUTH_ROOT: A malicious same-UID process or external signer with authentication-key access can still forge authorization or race mutable package-tree bytes after verification. Closing this residual requires OS uid/service isolation, immutable mounted runtime bytes or a container image, and an external asymmetric signer.

dual_authority_recovery.lock_lease: fixed top_controller -> queue_mutation -> stage_controller -> repair2_controller -> continuation_controller order; guarded writes/processes/notifications retain same-FD exclusive locks, while controller-spawned children reuse inherited pass_fds descriptions
